Alex Paulsen.note: Paulsen stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He leaves his line early when a through ball escapes the back line. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Alex Paulsen.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会直塞球越过后防时及时出击。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Alex Rufer.note: Watch Rufer for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over.
Alex Rufer.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。他也会第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。

Ben Old.note: Watch Old for carrying momentum through open midfield. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Ben Old.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。留意他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Ben Waine.note: Waine's edge is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Ben Waine.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Callan Elliot.note: Elliot's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Callan Elliot.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Chris Wood.note: Wood's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Chris Wood.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Elijah Just.note: Just is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Elijah Just.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Finn Surman.note: Surman's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Finn Surman.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Francis de Vries.note: De Vries offers left-side balance, useful for early service and steady defensive width.
Francis de Vries.noteZh: 德弗里斯提供左侧平衡，适合早传和稳定的防守宽度。

Francis De Vries.note: Vries is defined by delivering the ball without needing much space. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Francis De Vries.noteZh: 他靠在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Jesse Randall.note: Randall's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Jesse Randall.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Joe Bell.note: Bell is defined by moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Joe Bell.noteZh: 他靠用传球的力度和角度移动防线与同位置球员拉开差异。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Kosta Barbarouses.note: Barbarouses is defined by calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Kosta Barbarouses.noteZh: 他靠高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断与同位置球员拉开差异。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Lachlan Bayliss.note: Bayliss is defined by pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Lachlan Bayliss.noteZh: 他靠带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Liberato Cacace.note: Cacace is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Liberato Cacace.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Logan Rogerson.note: Watch Rogerson for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Logan Rogerson.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Marko Stamenic.note: Stamenic's edge is creating a better angle for the next pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Marko Stamenic.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Max Crocombe.note: Crocombe's edge is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Max Crocombe.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在危险出现前组织好队友。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Callum McCowatt.note: McCowatt's edge is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Callum McCowatt.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Michael Boxall.note: Watch Boxall for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Michael Boxall.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在危险出现前组织好队友。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Michael Woud.note: Woud's signature is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Michael Woud.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注上。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Nando Pijnaker.note: Pijnaker's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Nando Pijnaker.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Ryan Thomas.note: Watch Thomas for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Ryan Thomas.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。留意他如何第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Sarpreet Singh.note: Watch Singh for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Sarpreet Singh.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Tim Payne.summary: Tim Payne is a New Zealand right-back from Wellington Phoenix who gives the national team right-back reliability, wide defending, and overlap support.
Tim Payne.note: Payne's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Tim Payne.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Tommy Smith.summary: Tommy Smith is a New Zealand centre-back from Auckland FC who gives the national team experience, aerial duels, and back-line organization.
Tommy Smith.note: Smith is defined by calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Tommy Smith.noteZh: 他靠高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Tyler Bindon.note: Bindon's signature is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Tyler Bindon.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构上。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。
